articles.title: The Teenager Who Conquered the WTA Finals
articles.summary: Nervous before the tournament, 19-year-old Mirra Andreeva won the WTA Finals without dropping a set, becoming its youngest champion in 22 years.

articles.title: Spider-Man Swings Back to Theaters
articles.summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day returns to theaters December 4 in an extended cut, chasing $1 billion and an awards campaign.

articles.title: What Would You Ask an Animal?
articles.summary: Scientists are using AI to decode birdsong, whale calls and more, bringing a real conversation with animals closer than ever.
